import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    feature_cols = [
        "num_orders", "num_items", "total_price", "total_freight",
        "mean_price", "max_price", "min_price", "std_price",
        "nunique_seller", "nunique_customer", "mean_freight",
        "mean_review", "review_count", "mean_payment_total",
        "mean_payment_installments", "mean_payment_count",
        "days_since_last", "product_age_days", "sales_per_month",
        "review_rate", "mean_delivery_delay", "has_sales",
        "num_orders_30d", "num_orders_90d", "num_orders_180d",
        "trend_30_90", "price_trend", "mean_review_recent",
        "low_review_share"
    ]

    empty_df = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"),
                            columns=feature_cols)
    empty_df.index = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")

    # --- order_items: only purchases strictly before seed_time ---
    mask_items = order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids) & (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask_items].copy()
    if items.empty:
        return empty_df

    # --- orders: only information already known at seed_time ---
    # approved_at: approval must exist before seed_time; delivery dates only used
    # if delivery already happened before seed_time
    orders_sub = orders[[
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_delivered_customer_date",
        "order_estimated_delivery_date",
    ]].copy()
    items = items.merge(orders_sub, how="left", on="order_id")

    # --- payments: only payments recorded before seed_time ---
    pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
        pay_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        pay_total=("payment_value", "sum"),
        pay_install_avg=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # --- reviews: only reviews already created before seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev.groupby("order_id").agg(
        rev_count=("review_score", "count"),
        rev_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # --- delivery delay: only for orders delivered before seed_time ---
    delivered = items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & \
        (items["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    items["delivery_delay"] = np.where(
        delivered,
        (items["order_delivered_customer_date"] - items["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.days,
        np.nan,
    )

    items["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(items["ts"])
    cutoff_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    cutoff_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    cutoff_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    grouped = items.groupby("product_id")

    feature_agg = pd.DataFrame({
        "num_orders": grouped["order_id"].nunique(),
        "num_items": grouped["price"].count(),
        "total_price": grouped["price"].sum(),
        "total_freight": grouped["freight_value"].sum(),
        "mean_price": grouped["price"].mean(),
        "max_price": grouped["price"].max(),
        "min_price": grouped["price"].min(),
        "std_price": grouped["price"].std(),
        "nunique_seller": grouped["seller_id"].nunique(),
        "nunique_customer": grouped["customer_id"].nunique(),
        "mean_freight": grouped["freight_value"].mean(),
        "mean_review": grouped["rev_mean"].mean(),
        "review_count": grouped["rev_count"].sum(),
        "mean_payment_total": grouped["pay_total"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_installments": grouped["pay_install_avg"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_count": grouped["pay_count"].mean(),
        "mean_delivery_delay": grouped["delivery_delay"].mean(),
        "first_ts": grouped["ts"].min(),
        "last_ts": grouped["ts"].max(),
        "mean_price_30d": grouped.apply(
            lambda g: g.loc[g["ts"] >= cutoff_30, "price"].mean(), include_groups=False),
        "mean_price_prior": grouped.apply(
            lambda g: g.loc[g["ts"] < cutoff_30, "price"].mean(), include_groups=False),
        "num_orders_30d": grouped.apply(
            lambda g: g.loc[g["ts"] >= cutoff_30, "order_id"].nunique(), include_groups=False),
        "num_orders_90d": grouped.apply(
            lambda g: g.loc[(g["ts"] >= cutoff_90) & (g["ts"] < cutoff_30),
                            "order_id"].nunique(), include_groups=False),
        "mean_review_recent": grouped.apply(
            lambda g: g.loc[(g["ts"] >= cutoff_180) & g["rev_mean"].notna(),
                            "rev_mean"].mean(), include_groups=False),
    })

    # share of low reviews among known reviews
    low_share = items.dropna(subset=["rev_mean"]).groupby("product_id")["rev_mean"] \
        .apply(lambda s: (s < 3).mean())
    feature_agg["low_review_share"] = low_share

    # time-based features
    feature_agg["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - feature_agg["last_ts"]).dt.days
    feature_agg["product_age_days"] = (seed_time - feature_agg["first_ts"]).dt.days
    age_positive = feature_agg["product_age_days"].clip(lower=1)
    feature_agg["sales_per_month"] = feature_agg["num_orders"] * 30 / age_positive
    feature_agg["review_rate"] = feature_agg["review_count"] / feature_agg["num_orders"]

    # trend: sales in last 30d vs prior 90d window
    denom = feature_agg["num_orders_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    feature_agg["trend_30_90"] = feature_agg["num_orders_30d"] / denom

    # price trend: recent avg price vs older avg price
    feature_agg["price_trend"] = feature_agg["mean_price_30d"] - feature_agg["mean_price_prior"]

    feature_agg["has_sales"] = 1

    feature_agg = feature_agg.drop(columns=["first_ts", "last_ts",
                                            "mean_price_30d", "mean_price_prior"],
                                   errors="ignore")
    feature_agg = feature_agg.reindex(columns=feature_cols)
    feature_agg = feature_agg.fillna(0)
    feature_agg = feature_agg.reindex(pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"), fill_value=0)
    return feature_agg
